name: Nukarumi ~Onna-tachi no Choukyou Nisshi~
original_name: ぬかるみ ～女たちの調教日誌～
source:
Main character enters university and starts to live alone. He frequents adult sites and one day identifies childhood friend's mother in one of the models. She surrenders to blackmail, and her training starts. At the same time protagonist keeps searching new victims on the net setting up an internet site to record the pattern of the training.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/04/vn-of-month-september-2002-masaru.html]vndbreview[/url]]
